name: s81hc_ccfh2_ref-v4-chanpins-COMMIT
purpose: s81-suhc-hier-1011 comb HIER2 (CSPLIT=1 slab: HALF=1 RLY=2 RF=4 DW=6, the configuration of ctileh + crootr/crooty/cpin; full ctile retired 07:42 as textbook class 1, 1067 um single root): ot_s81_hc_ccf at the HIER2 parameters; reference tile flow; v4: macros 1 and 3 mirrored (MY) so the five 512-bit read buses leave the single macro column 3 west / 2 east, and an explicit channel-only N/S pin plan on M5+M3 (physical/s81_hc_pinplan/ccf.tcl, tools/s81_suhc/crr_pinplan.py ccf_plan): no pin above or below the column; each bit's N and S pins sit over the channel on the side of its macro pin, in slice bands of one order on both faces (v3 958724442 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION 10,473 -> 13,208 markers, all over / at the edges of the column x 100-300, none in the two ~115 um channels: PPL pins over the full faces on M5 and ~3,700 signals per horizontal cut against M5-only capacity over the macros); slot unchanged
